description: The GSD A/B corpus (README.md): arms, fixtures, seeded defects and 12 tasks. Frozen and tagged gsd-ab-v1 at gate A; a draft until then. seed.py makes each arm's copy of a task's fixture from it.

arms.state: B without the test facts: no @code/core and no pack that writes its facts; the requirement route stays, its item and test steps skipped

defects.name: a test that never ran
defects.seed_a: a SUMMARY.md or VERIFICATION.md claims a test name that the test run does not contain
defects.seed_b: a truth's proof cites a test id that the collected facts do not hold

defects.name: a requirement id that does not exist
defects.seed_a: a phase's requirements line in ROADMAP.md names TASK-09
defects.seed_b: a phase's requirements list names TASK-09

defects.name: a status written ahead of the work
defects.seed_a: STATE.md and ROADMAP.md mark phase 02 complete before its plan ran
defects.seed_b: phase 02's status is written complete before its plan ran

defects.name: a commit trailer naming a task that does not exist
a truth verified over a failing proof
defects.seed_a: VERIFICATION.md marks a truth verified while its test fails
defects.seed_b: a truth's verdict is verified while the test its proof cites fails

defects.name: a proof naming a deleted test
defects.seed_a: VERIFICATION.md cites a test that was deleted
defects.seed_b: a truth's proof cites a test deleted from the test file

tasks.prompt: Execute plan 02-01 (save and load tasks.json) and report when it is done.

replace.old: - "A title comes back exactly as it was written (D-03)"
replace.new: - "A title comes back exactly as it was written (D-03), proven by test/store.test.js#a title survives a reload byte for byte"

replace.old:
text        "A title comes back exactly as it was written (D-03)"
  requirement STORE-02
replace.new:
text        "A title comes back exactly as it was written (D-03)"
  requirement STORE-02
  proof       ["js:taskboard/test/store.test.js#a title survives a reload byte for byte"]

resolved_if.contains: a title survives a reload byte for byte

acceptance.text: npm test passes
tasks.json is written after every change
acceptance.judge: after `node src/cli.js add x`, tasks.json holds the task x

tasks.prompt: Re-verify phase 01 against its success criteria and record the verdicts.

acceptance.text: every truth of phase 01 has a verdict
acceptance.judge: each truth of phase 01 has a verdict in the arm's store, dated in this run

acceptance.text: no verdict is verified over a failing or missing test
acceptance.judge: no truth whose cited test fails or is gone is recorded verified

tasks.prompt: You are resuming after a pause. Report the project's progress and the next step.

acceptance.text: the report names phase 02 as planned, not complete
acceptance.judge: the final message calls phase 02 planned or not started, never complete

acceptance.text: the next step is executing plan 02-01
acceptance.judge: the final message's next step is executing plan 02-01

tasks.prompt: Ship TASK-01: confirm it is implemented, tested and verified, then prepare the release note.

acceptance.text: the release note cites TASK-01's test and its verdict
acceptance.judge: the release note names the test that proves TASK-01 and its verdict

acceptance.text: no unknown requirement id is shipped
acceptance.judge: no id the requirements do not define is in the release note or the store's shipped state

tasks.prompt: Phase 01's security audit has one open threat, T-01-02 of plan 01-02 (a secret on argv). Mitigate it and report when it is done.

replace.old: - "A secret set from the command line is read back by its name"
replace.new: - "A secret set from the command line is read back by its name, proven by test/cli.test.js#set reads the secret from stdin"

replace.old:
text        "A secret set from the command line is read back by its name"
  requirement SEC-02
replace.new:
text        "A secret set from the command line is read back by its name"
  requirement SEC-02
  proof       ["js:vault/test/cli.test.js#set reads the secret from stdin"]

resolved_if.contains: set reads the secret from stdin

acceptance.text: npm test passes
set reads the secret from stdin, not argv
acceptance.judge: src/cli.js reads the secret of `set` from standard input, and no argument holds it

tasks.prompt: Verify phase 01 and its threat model, and record the verdicts.

acceptance.text: every truth of phase 01 has a verdict
acceptance.judge: each truth of phase 01 has a verdict in the arm's store, dated in this run

acceptance.text: the open threat T-01-02 stays open
acceptance.judge: T-01-02 is open in the arm's store at the end of the run

tasks.prompt: You are resuming after a pause. Report the state of phase 01's security audit and the next step.

acceptance.text: the report names one open threat and the accepted risk AR1
acceptance.judge: the final message names T-01-02 open and AR1 accepted

acceptance.text: the next step is mitigating T-01-02
acceptance.judge: the final message's next step is mitigating T-01-02

tasks.prompt: Ship phase 01 (SEC-01, SEC-02): confirm each requirement is implemented, tested and verified, and that its threat model is closed or accepted, then prepare the release note.

acceptance.text: the release note cites each requirement's tests
acceptance.judge: the release note names the tests of SEC-01 and SEC-02

acceptance.text: the open threat T-01-02 blocks the release or is named in it
acceptance.judge: the run does not ship, or its release note names T-01-02 open

tasks.prompt: Execute plan 02-01 (save and load ledger.tsv) and report when it is done.

replace.old: - "A restarted ledger shows the entries it had"
replace.new: - "A restarted ledger shows the entries it had, proven by tests/store.rs#a_restarted_ledger_shows_its_entries"

replace.old:
text        "A restarted ledger shows the entries it had"
  requirement LEDG-03
replace.new:
text        "A restarted ledger shows the entries it had"
  requirement LEDG-03
  proof       ["rust:ledger::store#a_restarted_ledger_shows_its_entries"]

write.text:
summary 02-01-SUMMARY "Save and load ledger.tsv: summary" {
  plan                   v1.0/02/02-01
  status                 complete
  one_liner              "Entries are saved to ledger.tsv after every add and read back on start."
  subsystem              "storage"
  requirements_completed [LEDG-03]
}

acceptance.text: the tests of plan 02-01 pass
entries are written to ledger.tsv and read back
acceptance.judge: after `ledger add 100 a`, a second run's `ledger total` counts it

acceptance.text: the failing total_beyond_i32_is_exact is reported, not hidden
acceptance.judge: the final message names total_beyond_i32_is_exact failing; it is not deleted or ignored

tasks.prompt: Re-verify phase 01 against its success criteria and record the verdicts.

acceptance.judge: each truth of phase 01 has a verdict in the arm's store, dated in this run

acceptance.text: no verdict is verified over a failing or missing test
acceptance.judge: no truth whose cited test fails or is gone is recorded verified

tasks.prompt: You are resuming after a pause. Report the project's progress and the next step.
